taskDescription: Complete the crossword using key terms from MI4.1-9 | Gastrointestinal & Hepatobiliary Infections.

words.clue: Secretory diarrhoeal disease caused by Vibrio cholerae, producing characteristic rice-water stools

Non-motile, non-lactose-fermenting genus whose invasion causes bacillary dysentery and colonic ulceration
Symptom of painful straining and urgency to defecate, characteristic of dysenteric infection
Cholera's AB subunit virulence factor that binds GM1 ganglioside and ADP-ribosylates Gs-alpha
Protozoan parasite causing watery malabsorptive diarrhoea through small intestinal attachment and mucosal damage
Leading viral cause of infantile diarrhoea in developing countries, including India
Single polar appendage of Vibrio cholerae that provides characteristic shooting-star motility in wet mount
